summary: Project to redesign the app homepage to be more user-friendly and visually appealing, shifting from a straight order dashboard to a clean, futuristic landing-style experience.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract clean futuristic grid/glow hero background, dark with subtle chrome accents (landing-hero-bg.dim_2400x1350.png)

existing_features.title: Redesign the public homepage (route "/") to feel like a clean, futuristic, user-friendly landing page rather than a basic dashboard-style page, while keeping the overall app navigation and authentication flow intact.

Update the existing LandingPage implementation to include additional landing-page sections beyond the current hero + 4-step grid, such as a benefits/features section and a clear next-step section that directs users to sign in (and/or sign up) using Internet Identity.

Implement a consistent clean/futuristic visual theme for the homepage redesign (colors, typography, layout, subtle futuristic accents like grid lines/glow), aligned with the existing dark-mode default and current Tailwind token system.
Add a new generated static hero background image asset and use it on the homepage hero section as a subtle futuristic backdrop (do not serve it from the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Redesign homepage into a more user-friendly, visually appealing clean/futuristic landing page (not a straight order dashboard)

projectName: Redesign homepage into a clean, futuristic landing experience
